objects.notes: Input edge: reads the staging feed table written by custbill-feed.
Validated parse output (cust_id, cust_name, bill_date ISO, bill_amount 2dp, currency, record_type).
Expectation-failed records: bad length, bad date, unknown currency/record_type, implied-decimal overflow.
Month-end rollup keyed (currency, record_type): RecordCount + TotalAmount, matching finance_billing_*.csv.
Deploy object: the Lakeflow Declarative Pipeline itself (pipeline definition, expectations, quarantine sink).
